apple.name: FamCall: Simple Voice Calls

apple.promotional_text: A little signal. A familiar voice. Call your people with a simple app designed with weak and unstable internet in mind. English and Persian included.
apple.description:
A little signal. A familiar voice.

Some conversations are worth making time for, even when the internet has other plans. FamCall keeps voice calling simple, with weak and unstable connections in mind.

YOUR PEOPLE, ONE SIMPLE LIST
Add a name and phone number, or choose someone from your phone’s contacts. Tap a person to call. Only the contacts you choose are added.

JUST WANT TO DIAL?
Open the keypad, enter a number with its country code, and call another FamCall user. No need to save the number first.

LESS TO THINK ABOUT
Verify your phone number once and stay signed in. No password or meeting link to remember. Clear controls for mute, speaker and ending a call keep the conversation front and center.

KEEP UP WITH YOUR CALLS
See recent and missed calls. Edit or remove saved people, block an unwanted number, and unblock it whenever you choose.

FAMILIAR IN MORE WAYS
Choose English or Persian. Enjoy a clear light or dark appearance that follows your phone’s theme.

MADE WITH IMPERFECT CONNECTIONS IN MIND
FamCall focuses on voice. If a connection is interrupted, it tries to reconnect and shows you what is happening.

Both people need FamCall and an internet connection. Calls are between FamCall users, not ordinary telephone lines. Availability and performance depend on both connections and phone settings. Mobile data charges may apply. FamCall does not support emergency calls.

Questions or feedback? info@silvergridtech.com
Privacy: https://famcall.web.app/privacy

Developed by SilverGrid Technology LLC.

beta.testflight_description:
FamCall is a simple voice-calling app designed with weak and unstable internet connections in mind.

This internal test version focuses on phone-number signup, adding contacts, incoming calls, two-way voice, and recovery after short connection interruptions. Both callers need the test app and internet access.

Help us find the moments when a call takes too long to ring, speech becomes hard to follow, or reconnection needs improvement. Send feedback through TestFlight or email info@silvergridtech.com.

This is an early test version from SilverGrid Technology LLC. Features and performance may change before release.
beta.testflight_what_to_test:
FamCall 0.2.0

This update brings a simpler interface, direct dialing, English and Persian, and incoming-call fixes.

Please check:
• People: search, add, swipe to edit/remove, and update a saved phone number.
• Dial pad: the centered button opens a bottom sheet. Enter a number with + or 00 and its country code to call another FamCall user.
• Calls: receive and answer with the phone locked or FamCall in the background; check mute, speaker and hangup.
• Settings: switch between English and Persian. Both use the same left-to-right layout and your choice stays saved.
• Log out and sign back in without deleting your account.
• Account deletion: verification and clear confirmation before permanent deletion.

The other person also needs FamCall. Network and phone settings can affect delivery. FamCall does not support emergency calls.
beta.play_internal_release_notes:
FamCall 0.2.0
- Simpler people list, settings, call history and calling screens.
- Dial any FamCall number from the new bottom-sheet keypad.
- Edit contact names and numbers, or swipe to remove a contact.
- Log out without deleting your account.
- English and Persian, with the same left-to-right layout.
- Subtle haptic feedback and clearer account verification.
- Incoming-call and session-recovery fixes.

Please test incoming calls with the phone locked and FamCall in the background, call controls, language switching and contact editing. Android Force stop prevents incoming calls until the app is reopened.
beta.production_release_notes: Initial FamCall release with phone-number verification, optional device-contact access, manual contact entry, one-to-one voice calls, incoming-call controls, and reconnection after supported network interruptions.

Manual entry and optional contacts access work with normalized international numbers.
Two-way calling, background ringing, and call controls work on supported platforms.
Automatic reconnection and its status UI work under the documented network tests.
Weak-network positioning is supported by measured speech and connection results.
